name: workshop-synthesizer
description: Workshop Synthesis — recipes for turning workshop outputs into defensible decisions. The four moves (cluster, interpret, prioritize, narrate) plus six workshop-type recipes. Companion to The Synthesis Playbook by Bill Bulman.

plugins.name: workshop-synthesizer
plugins.description: 8 skills + 7 slash commands + 26 prompts. Discovery, strategic offsite, design sprint, ideation/roadmap, retro/post-mortem, training debrief, plus a framework skill and a prompt-library meta-skill. Each recipe ships with a pipeline agent that pauses at human-authorship checkpoints.
